query: Equinix Q2 2026 interconnections annualized gross bookings AI demand
normalized: 2026 ai annualized bookings demand equinix gross interconnections q2

output.content:
Equinix delivered **$424 million of annualized gross bookings in Q2 2026**, up **23% year over year**—its second-highest quarterly volume on record—and said this contributed to a record backlog. [[1]] 

The company added a record **9,700 net interconnections** during the quarter; interconnection revenue was **$453 million**, versus $407 million a year earlier. [[2]] 

AI appears to be a material demand driver rather than the only source of growth: management said the **vast majority of its largest Q2 deals were AI-workload-driven**, while characterizing demand as broad-based across networking, cloud and AI infrastructure. [[3]] [[1]] 

AI also supported capacity and sales momentum: Equinix recorded roughly **$110 million of presales**, taking combined bookings plus presales growth above **30%**, and expanded its development pipeline to **52 projects across 33 markets** to meet demand. [[3]] [[1]] 

The strategic read-through is that AI workloads are particularly favorable for Equinix’s interconnection model: management cited increasing deal density as customers secure power and compute capacity, while its ecosystem includes **8 of the top 10 model providers** and **8 of the top 10 neoclouds** running key networking workloads on the platform. [[3]]

sources.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook :: Equinix, Inc. (EQIX)
